proposal: The Mandate recommends that the President's Intelligence Advisory Board and its Intelligence Oversight Board be tasked with independent advice on major long-term national security matters, taking a broad look at critical trends and relying on unclassified and open-source information (p. 229).
remaining: A published tasking for independent advice on long-term trends using unclassified and open-source information (p. 229)
Any stated role for the Intelligence Oversight Board (p. 229)

flags: Stage moved from in_progress 25 to proposed 10 because the recommendation is a tasking, and appointments without a published tasking do not make it formally underway; the board's existence is routine across administrations.

review.mandate_note: Page 229 says the PIAB and its Intelligence Oversight Board should be tasked with independent, informed advice on major long-term national security matters, including a broader look at critical trends and their implications using unclassified and open-source information.

source_checks.note: Announcement of 2025-02-11: 12 members and a chair; role to advise on the most important security challenges and ensure the IC advances the President's agenda; no mention of long-term trends, open source or the Intelligence Oversight Board. Checked 2026-10-15.

significance.rationale: Assigning advisory boards independent long-term analysis is a procedural change affecting a small advisory body.

sources.title: President Trump Announces the President's Intelligence Advisory Board
White House names chair, members of Intelligence Advisory Board

status_summary: On 2025-02-11 the White House announced 12 appointments to the President's Intelligence Advisory Board and named a former Member of Congress as chair, so the board was reconstituted early in the term (whitehouse.gov; ExecutiveGov). The announcement says the board will advise the President on the nation's most important security challenges and help ensure the intelligence community advances the President's agenda; it does not mention long-term trends, open-source information or the Intelligence Oversight Board. No published tasking of the kind the Mandate describes was found.

timeline.event: The White House announced 12 appointments to the President's Intelligence Advisory Board and named its chair; the announcement describes a role of advising the President on major security challenges.

title: Task the PIAB and Intelligence Oversight Board with independent long-term security advice
uncertainties: The board's authorizing executive order was not fetched, and a Federal Register search of presidential documents since 2025-01-20 for the board's name returned no document. Searches of whitehouse.gov results and news (researcher: PIAB, chair, 2026 tasking; reviewer: one further search for 2026 board reports or reviews) found no later tasking, report or membership change. Any classified or non-public tasking would not appear. The Intelligence Oversight Board was not separately found in any result. The stated purpose of advancing the President's agenda differs in emphasis from the independent, long-term advice the Mandate describes.
